items.title: Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) Agreed to Sell Excel Industries. Will a Narrower Portfolio Improve Returns?
items.summary: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. (NYSE:SWK) entered into a definitive agreement to sell Excel Industries to Bad Boy Mowers. Excel Industries, which includes the Hustler Turf Equipment brand, is expected to generate approximately $300 million of fiscal 2026 revenue. The purchase price and expected proceeds were not disclosed. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approval […]
